parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main structural body of the refrigerator, made of stainless steel for durability and rigidity.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the insulation and cooling components of the refrigerator.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door is a large, flat panel made of stainless steel, attached to the frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the refrigerator interior and helps maintain internal temperature when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Side Controls
parts.Basic_description: The side controls are a plastic interface panel located on the refrigerator’s side or door.
parts.Functional_description: They allow the user to adjust temperature settings, modes, and other operational parameters.
parts.Movement_description: They include buttons or touch-sensitive areas that can be pressed or tapped.
